integrity: All displayed formulas are supported by a constructive polynomial-module proof. Standalone exact finite verification supplements but does not certify universal statements. No independent external review.
scientific_limitations: Binary three-dot subshift, square-periodic points, axis-parallel rectangular local patterns; does not address general sublattices, unequal periods, least periods or other alphabets. Mersenne square-period cardinalities already known in Miles and Ward (2015).
title: Sharp rectangular periodic-extension profiles of the Ledrappier three-dot shift
